stem: A data set consists of four positive integers \(a\), \(b\), \(c\) and \(d\), where \(a < b < c < d\). The mean of the data set is 10, the median is 9, and the range is 14. What is the value of \(d\)?
solution: Mean 10 means \(a + b + c + d = 40\). The median is the mean of the two middle values, so \(b + c = 18\).
Then \(a + d = 40 - 18 = 22\), and the range gives \(d - a = 14\).
verify:
a, d = symbols('a d')
sol = solve([Eq(a + d, 40 - 18), Eq(d - a, 14)], [a, d])
assert sol[d] == 18 and sol[a] == 4
assert any(sol[a] < b < c < sol[d] for b in range(5, 18) for c in range(5, 18) if b + c == 18)
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [18]
